title: Windows Named pipes invalid memory access
notes: Reported with a repro under Application Verifier; fixed in mio#1760 (RUSTSEC-2024-0019). When the task owning a NamedPipeServer with a pending overlapped connect is dropped (runtime shutdown after timeout), the IOCP completion is delivered after deregistration into a freed ScheduledIo. The overlapped op is in flight in the kernel -> kernel_or_remote/in_progress.

title: When terminating the vector of the S3 source, the imported message is terminated without completely processing it.

title: fix(source): drop stale wait checkpoint task
